sentences.en: Cycling is good exercise. Moreover, it doesn't pollute the air.
sentences.zh: 骑自行车是一项很好的锻炼。此外，它不会污染空气。

sentences.en: The cold winter wind was definitely a disincentive to cycling.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的冬风肯定是对骑自行车的一种阻碍。

sentences.en: You may go cycling if it doesn't rain.
sentences.zh: 如果不下雨的话，你可以去骑自行车。

senses.zh: 骑自行车v.循环;骑自行车;“cycle”的现在分词
